title: Hannele: 2-näytöksinen unirunoelma
summary: "Hannele: 2-näytöksinen unirunoelma" by Gerhart Hauptmann is a play written in 1893. The work tells the story of a neglected and abused peasant child who, on her deathbed, experiences a vision of divine powers welcoming her into the afterlife. Blending naturalistic drama with symbolist elements, the play features dream sequences and marks a historic first in world literature by centering a child as its heroine.
